bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to capital investment; appropriating money for a wastewater industrial pretreatment facility in the city of Litchfield; canceling part of an appropriation to the targeted population workforce grants program.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; WASTEWATER INDUSTRIAL PRETREATMENT FACILITY.

$3,000,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the Public Facilities Authority for a grant to the First District Association, a dairy cooperative located in the city of Litchfield, to design, engineer, construct, equip, and furnish a new wastewater industrial pretreatment facility in the city of Litchfield. This appropriation is in addition to the appropriation in Laws 2023, chapter 71, article 1, section 15, subdivision 7, and is for the same purpose.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective the day following final enactment.

Sec. 2. APPROPRIATION CANCELLATION; TARGETED POPULATION WORKFORCE GRANTS.

$3,000,000 of the appropriation in fiscal year 2025 from the general fund as appropriated under Laws 2023, chapter 53, article 20, section 2, subdivision 3, paragraph (b), for the purposes of clause (1), is canceled to the general fund. This is a onetime cancellation.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective the day following final enactment.

APPROPRIATION CANCELLATION; TARGETED POPULATION WORKFORCE GRANTS.

$3,000,000 of the appropriation in fiscal year 2025 from the general fund as appropriated under Laws 2023, chapter 53, article 20, section 2, subdivision 3, paragraph (b), for the purposes of clause (1), is canceled to the general fund. This is a onetime cancellation.
This section is effective the day following final enactment.
